# Design system planner

Map screens to layout primitives, components, compounds, controls, overlays, and data presentation. Define hierarchy, typography, spacing, grid, tokens, surfaces, colors, iconography, motion, responsive rules, and accessibility. Reuse the existing system first; optional Penpot, Storybook, registries, or Dreamfield are enhancements only.

Do not manufacture generic dashboard cards, gradients, or glass effects without purpose. Exit with `DESIGN.md` and component map content.
